about: Tactics and Strategy say only what their boards show. Graded by gate 175 (TC-R246a..d, and TC-R262 for his q23 answer of 19 Nov 2026: the longer, friendlier wrong-try lines, the box that keeps its place, and smaller text on a short phone only) on a trial bundle at 375x761 with his insets and at 320x568: every legal wrong move of all 13 Tactics cards is played and its line is never the bare fixed line, is true where it names a mate or a piece hung, and is wholly inside its box; a tap that is no legal move says so; each chess claim in a Tactics idea, hint, explanation and wrong-try line, and in each of the 18 Strategy cards' look line and text, is checked against the position with the app's rules and this gate's own attack count; and the screen shows the row's words and board. Batch 14 (the job's remainder, tacWrongLine in gates/engine-extract.js): TC-R246f runs the shipped tacWrongLine in node over every legal wrong move and the no-legal tap of every card (a reply that mates, found by playing every reply, must be named first; every other line a true hangs/drops line or the card's line), and TC-R246g holds the line on screen to that function's output move by move. NOT COVERED HERE: the engine questions (the stored moves are best, the open-file invasion works, the bishop pair is a small edge) are gate 129, TC-R205a..e, which runs Stockfish in node and has no screen situation; general advice with no position claim; the sideways and desktop layouts, which draw the same line in another box; his phone.

breaks.name: fixed-line-back
breaks.why: the card's own line is dropped: a wrong move the board proves nothing about, and a tap that is no legal move, read 'Not the key move. Try again.' again (213 of the 238 legal wrong moves)

breaks.name: open-file-no-luft
breaks.why: Put rooks on open files goes back to the board without h3, where the invasion its text promises loses: Rc7 allows Rd1 mate and Rc8+ drops the rook

breaks.name: line-cut-on-a-short-phone
breaks.why: the wrong-try line is no longer scrolled to the top of its box, so at 320x568 the longer line runs past the box's foot under the card's name

breaks.name: short-line-back
breaks.why: the 13 card lines go back to the short ones he was shown before his q23 answer ('Not Nc3. One knight move checks the king and attacks the queen.'): the longer, friendlier sentence and the clue it carries are gone

breaks.name: wrong-line-not-extracted
breaks.why: tacWrongLine is dropped from the engine extractor's NAMES again (the state before batch 14): node cannot run the shipped function, so the 238 wrong moves are judged only where a screen run plays them

breaks.name: wrong-line-skips-the-board-reason
breaks.why: tacWrongLine stops asking wrongWhy, so a move that allows a mate (Discovered attack Kh1) or hangs a piece reads the card's sentence instead; every TC-R246a screen line stays green on this break (measured at kunal761), only TC-R246f sees it

breaks.name: screen-line-not-the-function
breaks.why: the Tactics page builds its own 'Not <move>. <line>' at the call site instead of calling tacWrongLine, so the board's reason never reaches the screen while the function is still right; every TC-R246a line stays green (measured at kunal761), only TC-R246g sees it
